data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate released GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2017: GBP 39.4m), arising predominantly from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions. These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2018.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes, California wildfires)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The current estimated ultimate claims for these events were reported as GBP 335.5m gross (and GBP 99.1m net of reinsurance).

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Michael and Florence; Typhoons Jebi and Trami; Woolsey and Camp wildfires; Ituango hydroelectric dam (Colombia)
named_events.loss_description: The current estimated ultimate claims for these events are GBP 176.6m gross and GBP 62.1m net of reinsurance. After inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums this reduces to GBP 57.3m.

named_events.event_name: Hurricane Harvey, Hurricane Irma, Hurricane Maria, Two earthquakes in Mexico, numerous wildfires in California
named_events.loss_description: The current estimated ultimate claims for these events are GBP 335.5m gross and GBP 99.1m net of reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,962.8m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a net release of technical reserves in respect of prior periods of GBP 35.2m (a release of c.1.8% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven predominantly by favourable claims development across Treaty, Energy and Marine divisions. Separately, 2018 experienced a number of large catastrophe losses (hurricanes Michael and Florence, typhoons Jebi and Trami, Woolsey and Camp wildfires and the Ituango dam incident) for which the syndicate reported estimated ultimate gross claims of GBP 176.6m (net GBP 62.1m). 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes and California wildfires) remain material with combined gross estimated ultimate claims of GBP 335.5m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior year movement were taken from the technical reserves table and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative note respectively (explicit figures in the report). The claims development triangle is present but includes an aggregated '2010 and prior' column and the RITC (Reinsurance to Close) of the UK Division is shown elsewhere in the technical reserves note which can distort development comparatives. The PYD figure used is the stated movement in the movement note (assumed gross as presented in the note). Extraction of the full claims development triangle numeric grid from scanned images was only partially reliable; triangle reconstruction has therefore been omitted/limited and the RITC distortion should be considered when using the triangle.
